text:
```yaml
name: Check System Prompts

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run frontend tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Run backend tests
        run: cargo test --workspace --all-features

      - name: Check system prompts
        run: |
          if [ -f scripts/check-system-prompts.sh ]; then
            bash scripts/check-system-prompts.sh
          else
            echo "No system prompts check script found."
          fi
```
